# Matic Publish
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Next action: verify the active claim execution, publish only the measured and reconciled change as one branch and one PR targeting `staging`, then post a verified screenshot comment addressed to the issue author.

## Purpose

Commit and push the verified matic change, create one PR to `staging`, request Dennis Arquillano as reviewer, and leave one verified issue comment addressed to the issue author with a screenshot of the fix.

## Trigger

Run after Measure passes, Learn writes a verified `what-now.md`, and Reconcile is complete.

Do not run when the quality gate is failed or blocked, Learn is missing, the worktree contains unrelated changes, or a human release boundary is unresolved.

## Interface Contract

```text
Passed Measure + verified Learn + reconciled carriers + clean intended diff + safe screenshot -> commit, push, open review PR, and comment on issue -> publication record, PR, comment, and waiting run state
```

| Interface | Declaration |
|---|---|
| Inputs | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/04-measure/audit-findings.md`, `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/05-learn/what-now.md`, `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/04-reconcile/reconciliation-record.md`, `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-manifest.md`, `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md`, the verified remote claim record and execution ID, the selected GitHub issue metadata including its author login, the safe screenshot evidence named by Build and Measure, `workspace/_config/quality-policy.md`, `workspace/matic-workflow/claim-contract.md`, and `workspace/matic-workflow/github-lifecycle.md` |
| Transform | Verify publication readiness, commit intended files, push the matic branch, create the PR to `staging`, request the required reviewer, and post or reconcile the author-addressed screenshot comment on the issue |
| Outputs | `publication-record.md`, pushed branch, PR targeting `staging`, reviewer request, verified issue comment with screenshot, and updated `run-state.md` |

## Input Gate

- Measure says `Passed`, score is at least 80%, and every applicable criterion is `Pass`.
- Learn exists and identifies publication as the next action.
- Reconciliation is complete.
- The current branch is the run branch and its base is `origin/staging`.
- `git status` contains only intended files for the selected issue.
- The remote claim still identifies this run and the authenticated operator holds its active execution ID.
- The claim is rechecked immediately before commit, push, PR, and issue-comment writes.
- No unrelated open PR owns the branch and issue. If an exact PR is already recorded for a resumed run, inspect and reuse it instead of creating a duplicate.
- The issue author GitHub login is known and matches the selected issue.
- A safe screenshot demonstrates the fix and is stored at the run evidence path named by Build. A publishable URL can be resolved from the exact PR head commit after push, or an existing GitHub-hosted attachment URL is available. The screenshot contains no credentials, tokens, cookies, private keys, or real participant data.
- No unresolved human-only release or production decision is being smuggled into the PR.

## Transform

1. Verify the current claim and execution token.
2. Inspect the exact diff and run `git diff --check`.
3. Recheck the claim before each shared write. Commit only intended files with a concise issue-specific message, including the screenshot evidence when the repository URL hosting method is used.
4. Push without force-push.
5. Create one PR with base `staging`, or inspect the exact recorded PR when resuming. Include the issue number and title as a plain reference, scope, evidence, tests, PM Control links, limitations, and rollback notes.
6. Request review from `dennisatssd`.
7. Do not use `Closes`, `Fixes`, or another auto-close keyword.
8. Read the issue author's GitHub login and prepare a comment whose first visible line begins with `@<issue-author-login>`.
9. Add the marker `<!-- matic-pr-screenshot: issue-<issue-number>-pr-<pr-number> -->`, the linked PR number and human-readable title, and the screenshot markdown `![Screenshot of the fix](<screenshot-url>)`.
10. Post the comment with `gh issue comment`, or update the existing marked comment when resuming. Verify the author mention, PR link, screenshot URL, and resulting comment URL through GitHub. Do not create a duplicate marked comment.
11. Record the issue author, screenshot path and URL, comment URL, commit, branch, PR, review request, claim head, execution transition, and run state as `Awaiting merge` or `Awaiting review`. If comment creation or verification fails, record `Blocked` and the exact resume action instead.
12. Transition the claim to the matching idle waiting status through its execution token only after all publication evidence is verified.

| Output | Location | Format | Intended consumer |

| Publication record | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/05-publish/publication-record.md` | Markdown containing issue author, screenshot path and URL, comment URL, PR, commit, branch, reviewer, and waiting state | Close-merged stage and user |

| Claim state | `refs/heads/matic-claims/issue-<number>` | Git commit history with the waiting transition | All operators and close-merged stage |

## Verify

- The commit contains only intended files.
- The remote branch points to the recorded commit.
- The PR base is `staging`.
- The issue number and human-readable title are present without an auto-close keyword.
- Dennis Arquillano (`dennisatssd`) is requested.
- The first visible line of the issue comment begins with the selected issue author's GitHub mention.
- The issue comment contains the exact PR number and title, a safe screenshot, and a verified GitHub comment URL.
- The screenshot URL is not a local path or mutable branch URL and resolves to the recorded screenshot evidence.
- The exact PR number and title are recorded.
- The claim transition to `awaiting-review` or `awaiting-merge` was verified, and the execution token was cleared.
- The next route is `matic-workflow/stages/06-close-merged/CONTEXT.md`.

## Review Gate

Review. Stop after the PR and verified issue comment are created. Do not merge the PR or close the issue.
